vignette: A child presents for a routine dental visit. The clinical examination shows signs of enamel erosion.
stem: Which action is most appropriate when determining the etiology of this child's erosion?

options.text: Evaluate the patient for possible gastroesophageal reflux disease.
Reassure the family that erosion arises only from diet and that no medical evaluation is needed.
Encourage spicy foods as part of dietary counseling for erosion with reflux.
Advise avoiding spicy foods as the only step, without considering gastroesophageal reflux disease as a cause.
